observations.title: Use supported Cataclysm weapons in Epic Fight
observations.player_action: Equip a supported Cataclysm weapon while using Epic Fight combat.
observations.outcome: The patch assigns combat styles to Incinerator, Meat Shredder, Cursed Bow, Bulwark, Wrath of the Desert, Laser Gatling, Annihilator, Soul Render, Immolator, Coral Spear/Bardiche, both assault shoulder weapons and Ancient Spear.
conditions: The exact project is identified by author package frfefefe and matching EpicFight_X_L_Enders_Cataclysm-1.0.jar filename.
External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Read the effective Epic Fight item capability and its priority when P1nero's addon also patches a weapon. This compatibility mod does not supply an independent quest or guarantee all Cataclysm content works.

observations.title: Compare the patch's documented baseline with installed mods
observations.player_action: Review the author's Epic Fight 20.10.6 / Cataclysm 2.66 baseline before relying on it with 20.14.17 / 3.31.
observations.outcome: The installed pack is newer than the stated working combination; overlapping capability resources and special right-click effects need owner-level inspection.
